Bug_Details:
A null pointer is dereferenced here.  This will lead to a
NullPointerException when the code is executed. NullPointerException
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the line 'ArrayList<String> list = null;' by assigning a null value to the list variable, which is then dereferenced in the next line when calling the 'add' method.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug() method, which initializes the list variable to null, and then attempts to add an element to the list, resulting in a NullPointerException.
